text: In accordance with the City of Toronto's School Safety Zone initiative, I am requesting Scarborough Community Council support my motion requesting Transportation Services, to study the feasibility of a speed limit reduction on Centennial Road - from Lawson Road to Lawrence Avenue East in Ward 44 (Reduction from current 50 km/h to 40 km/h) and to report back to Scarborough Community Council for the June 6, 2018 community council session. I am also requesting Scarborough Community Council support my request that Transportation Services, study the feasibility of speed limit reductions on the following public roads and report back to the July 4, 2018 Scarborough Community Council session: 1.
